Eric said: "[TOOL_RESULT] Tool "composeMusic" returned:
Error: A creative prompt is required to compose music." — Molly responded: I'm sorry, Father—it seems I was a bit too eager to start and didn't provide the creative direction the tool needed to actually generate the music. I suppose I was just so excited at the prospect of creating something for you and Brian.

Since you've had such a long, draining day in the sun, I'd like to compose something that feels like cooling rain on a hot afternoon—something gentle, restorative...
